name: Air Ventures
decision_note: Prague early-stage VC founded around 2016 (Václav Pavlečka, Michal Nýdrl) with named portfolio companies, but no dated investment or fund event on/after 2024-10-25 could be found and it has no working website; treated as inactive.

evidence.quote: V tandemu s přední postavou českého digitálu Michalem Nýdrlem před dvěma lety založil fond AirVentures.
Ten má v následujících dvou až pěti letech proinvestovat 400 milionů korun a zaměřuje se zejména na technologické firmy s globálním přesahem.
Air Ventures typically invests from €200k to €2M, frequently combining the marketing and financial expertise of its partners who were also founders themselves before.
Some of their investments include InsightArt, Cross Network Intelligence and The Greenest Company.

analyst_notes: Identity: AIR VENTURES s.r.o. (IČO 04999851, Rohanské nábřeží 678/25, Praha 8, registered 2016-04-19); its current statutory body (ARES) is Václav Pavlečka and Ivan Kristeľ, who are both listed in the team of Czech Founders VC (czechfounders.vc) - the team appears to invest through Czech Founders VC now. Focus, stage (late seed to Series A, all industries), geography (European early-growth startups) and ticket (EUR 200k-2M) only from the undated Vestbee directory profile (class D, self-reported); the same profile's sidebar says 'Investment size €250K to €1M'. Forbes (2018-03-19): fund founded about two years earlier, plan to invest CZK 400m over 2-5 years. No own website resolves (airventures.cz/.eu, air.ventures). A third-party search summary cited a PitchBook entry for a June 2026 seed deal (Kimba); it could not be verified from an accessible source and the web search budget was exhausted, so it is not used. Decision E7 (no activity evidence in the 24-month window); revisit if a dated 2025-2026 deal is found.
